subject: Your FF Digest

disagreements.detail: High expert disagreement: rank 6-20 (std 3.13) -- highest: Mike Harmon (#5), lowest: Nathan Jahnke (#21)

news.title: Ja'Marr Chase remains in concussion protocol
news.impact: Chase was in uniform during practice on Friday. He will have till Saturday to clear all protocols in time for Sunday.

news.title: Cam Skattebo (shoulder) will play Sunday
news.impact: Skattebo said he had a "little muscle tightness" in his shoulder. It's why he wore a red no-contact jersey on Wednesday. He'll remain a steady RB2 play.

news.title: Ryan Flournoy goes for 90 yards in loss
news.impact: Flournoy stepped in and made some big plays while operating as the Cowboys' WR2/3 on Thursday with CeeDee Lamb in and out of the lineup due to injury. If Lamb or George Pickens were to miss any time, Flournoy would be a primary pickup.

news.title: Andrew Wingard (knee) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Wingard will be sidelined with a knee injury.

news.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) trending in right direction for Sunday
news.impact: Love will continue to manage his ankle injury. He appears likely to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Lions.

narrative: Two things worth your attention this week. Dak Prescott has the experts arguing with themselves — he's ranked anywhere from 6th to 20th at QB (std dev 3.13), with Mike Harmon bullish at #5 and Nathan Jahnke sitting him all the way down at #21. That's a spread wide enough to drive a truck through, so trust your own read on the matchup. Elsewhere, Mike Evans is now officially OUT with a hamstring issue — time to work the waiver wire if he was in your lineup plans.
